title: Lowest point velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the ball's speed at the lowest point using conservation of energy and momentum.

title: Groove displacement
description: Essential: Correctly determines the groove's horizontal displacement when the ball reaches the lowest point.

title: Trajectory equation
description: Essential: Correctly derives the equation of the ball's trajectory in the ground-fixed frame.

title: Specific condition velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the ball's speed relative to ground at height b/2 given the mass ratio condition.

title: Conservation of momentum
description: Important: Applies conservation of horizontal momentum to relate ball and groove velocities/displacements.

title: Conservation of energy
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy correctly, accounting for both masses' kinetic energy.

title: Geometric constraint
description: Important: Uses the ellipse geometry or the constraint that relative horizontal displacement sums to 'a'.

title: Coordinate transformation
description: Optional: Correctly transforms from the moving groove frame to the ground-fixed frame for the trajectory.

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign in horizontal momentum conservation equation (e.g., adding instead of subtracting).

title: Energy omission
description: Pitfall: Omits the groove's kinetic energy in the energy conservation equation.
